description: 【和歌山県】津波浸水想定図(東海・東南海・南海3連動地震) [flood and tsunami] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 和歌山県. 東海・東南海・南海3連動地震による浸水想定図を掲載しています。 和歌山県では南海トラフの巨大地震等に係る津波浸水・地震被害想定を実施するにあたり、地震・津波防災対策の専門家から、科学的知見に基づいた助言をいただくために「和歌山県地震・津波被害想定検討委員会」（以下「委員会」という。 ）を平成24年4月に設置して検討を行い、委員会での意見を... Coverage: 和歌山県. The portal files it under the publisher 和歌山県. Its tags are 3連動地震, マップ, 地図, 地理, 地震. It offers 2 resource(s) in html, zip. The portal shows 2024-03-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
